summary.zh: 不定式通常指“to + 动词原形”，也包括不带 to 的 bare infinitive。它不受主语人称和时态限制，不能单独作句子的谓语，但可以在句中作主语、宾语、表语、定语、状语或宾语补足语。在 PTE Academic 和 IELTS 中，不定式常用于表达目的、计划、倾向、结果、评价和学术立场，是提升句子复杂度和语法准确性的核心结构。中国学习者需要特别注意不定式与动名词 gerund 的区别、bare infinitive 的使用条件，以及不定式的逻辑主语和被动形式。

structure.formula: to + base verb；bare infinitive = base verb；negative infinitive = not to + base verb；passive infinitive = to be + past participle；perfect infinitive = to have + past participle
structure.explanation: 不定式的基本形式是“to + 动词原形”，例如 to study, to improve, to analyze。它可以表示尚未发生、计划发生、目的性或抽象性的动作。bare infinitive 是不带 to 的动词原形，常出现在情态动词之后，或某些使役动词和感官动词之后。否定形式是在 to 前加 not，即 not to do。被动不定式表示“被做”，形式为 to be done。完成式不定式 to have done 常表示动作发生在谓语动作之前，在高分写作和阅读中较常见。

examples.en: Many students aim to improve their academic writing before the exam.
examples.zh: 许多学生目标是在考试前提高学术写作能力。

examples.en: The policy is designed to reduce carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 该政策旨在减少碳排放。

examples.en: Candidates should not to memorize full essays.
examples.zh: 错误示例：考生不应该去背诵整篇作文。

examples.en: Candidates should not memorize full essays.
examples.zh: 正确表达：考生不应该背诵整篇作文。情态动词 should 后使用 bare infinitive。

usage_scenarios.title: 作宾语：跟在特定动词后
usage_scenarios.description: 许多动词后常接不定式作宾语，表示计划、决定、希望、尝试或拒绝等含义。常见动词包括 decide, plan, hope, intend, agree, refuse, manage, fail, learn, offer。PTE 写作和口语中，这类结构可用于清晰表达目标和行动。

examples.en: The researchers decided to conduct a larger survey.
examples.zh: 研究人员决定开展一项更大规模的调查。

examples.en: The government plans to invest more in public transport.
examples.zh: 政府计划在公共交通方面投入更多资金。

usage_scenarios.title: 作目的状语：表示“为了……”
usage_scenarios.description: 不定式常用于说明动作目的，相当于 in order to 或 so as to。学术写作中，为了增强正式性，可以使用 in order to；但在简洁表达中，直接使用 to do 也很自然。

examples.en: Many cities introduce bike-sharing schemes to reduce traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 许多城市推出共享单车项目，以减少交通拥堵。

examples.en: Students need to read widely in order to develop critical thinking skills.
examples.zh: 学生需要广泛阅读，以培养批判性思维能力。

usage_scenarios.title: 作主语：表达抽象行为
usage_scenarios.description: 不定式可以作主语，但在现代英语中，更常使用形式主语 it，将真正主语不定式放在后面。该结构在 IELTS Task 2 和 PTE Essay 中非常常见。

examples.en: To solve this problem requires cooperation from different sectors.
examples.zh: 解决这个问题需要不同部门的合作。

examples.en: It is essential to protect personal data in the digital age.
examples.zh: 在数字时代，保护个人数据至关重要。

usage_scenarios.title: 作表语：说明主语的目的或内容
usage_scenarios.description: 不定式可放在 be 动词后作表语，用来说明计划、目标、任务或建议的内容。这种结构常用于定义目标和政策意图。

examples.en: The main objective is to increase access to higher education.
examples.zh: 主要目标是增加接受高等教育的机会。

examples.en: The best solution may be to combine regulation with public education.
examples.zh: 最佳解决方案可能是将监管与公众教育结合起来。

usage_scenarios.title: 作定语：修饰名词
usage_scenarios.description: 不定式可放在名词后作后置定语，表示将要做的事、可做的事或需要完成的任务。常见搭配包括 a way to do, an opportunity to do, the ability to do, a decision to do, efforts to do。

examples.en: Online courses provide students with opportunities to learn independently.
examples.zh: 在线课程为学生提供了自主学习的机会。

examples.en: There is an urgent need to address income inequality.
examples.zh: 现在迫切需要解决收入不平等问题。

usage_scenarios.title: 作宾语补足语：verb + object + to do
usage_scenarios.description: 一些动词后可接“宾语 + 不定式”，表示让某人做某事、鼓励某人做某事或要求某人做某事。常见动词包括 encourage, allow, require, enable, persuade, advise, expect, force。该结构在学术英语中常用于说明政策、技术或教育如何影响人的行为。

examples.en: Digital tools enable learners to access information more efficiently.
examples.zh: 数字工具使学习者能够更高效地获取信息。

examples.en: Teachers often encourage students to evaluate sources critically.
examples.zh: 教师经常鼓励学生批判性地评估信息来源。

usage_scenarios.title: 使用 bare infinitive：不带 to 的不定式
usage_scenarios.description: bare infinitive 主要用于情态动词之后，如 can, may, must, should, could, would；也用于 make, let, help 以及感官动词 see, hear, watch, notice 后的某些结构中。注意：被动语态中 make 后要恢复 to，例如 be made to do。

examples.en: Students should develop the ability to compare different viewpoints.
examples.zh: 学生应该培养比较不同观点的能力。

examples.en: The new policy may help reduce unemployment.
examples.zh: 新政策可能有助于减少失业。

examples.en: Employees were made to work overtime during the peak season.
examples.zh: 员工在旺季被要求加班。

usage_scenarios.title: 不定式的被动形式：to be done
usage_scenarios.description: 当不定式的逻辑宾语承受动作时，使用被动不定式 to be done。该结构在学术写作中常用于客观表达，尤其适合描述政策、研究、措施和问题。

examples.en: More resources need to be allocated to rural schools.
examples.zh: 需要将更多资源分配给农村学校。

examples.en: The issue has to be addressed through long-term planning.
examples.zh: 这个问题必须通过长期规划来解决。

usage_scenarios.title: 不定式的完成式：to have done
usage_scenarios.description: 完成式不定式表示不定式动作发生在谓语动作之前，常见于 appear, seem, claim, be likely 等结构中。它能体现更高层次的时间关系，在阅读理解和高分写作中较常出现。

examples.en: The company appears to have underestimated the environmental risks.
examples.zh: 该公司似乎低估了环境风险。

examples.en: The policy is believed to have improved access to healthcare.
examples.zh: 人们认为该政策已经改善了医疗服务的可及性。

common_mistakes.wrong: Many students want improve their speaking skills.
common_mistakes.correct: Many students want to improve their speaking skills.
common_mistakes.explanation: want 后需要接不定式作宾语，不能直接接动词原形。中文“想提高”没有明显的 to 标记，因此中国学习者容易漏掉 to。

common_mistakes.wrong: The government should to reduce pollution.
common_mistakes.explanation: 情态动词 should, can, must, may 后必须接 bare infinitive，即动词原形，不加 to。

common_mistakes.wrong: It is important protect the environment.
common_mistakes.correct: It is important to protect the environment.
common_mistakes.explanation: 在“It is + adjective + to do”结构中，真正主语是不定式，to 不能省略。

common_mistakes.wrong: The teacher made students to rewrite the essay.
common_mistakes.correct: The teacher made students rewrite the essay.
common_mistakes.explanation: 主动语态中 make + object + bare infinitive，不使用 to。但被动语态要说 students were made to rewrite the essay。

common_mistakes.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
common_mistakes.correct: I look forward to hearing from you.
common_mistakes.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，不是不定式标志，因此后面接动名词 hearing，而不是动词原形 hear。

common_mistakes.wrong: The problem is difficult to be solved.
common_mistakes.correct: The problem is difficult to solve.
common_mistakes.explanation: 在“主语 + be + adjective + to do”结构中，如果主语是 to do 的逻辑宾语，通常使用主动形式表达被动含义，如 difficult to solve, easy to understand。

common_mistakes.wrong: There are many measures to reducing crime.
common_mistakes.correct: There are many measures to reduce crime.
common_mistakes.explanation: 这里 to reduce crime 是不定式作定语，修饰 measures，表示“减少犯罪的措施”。不能误用 to + doing，除非 to 是介词。

common_mistakes.wrong: The data is used to analyzing consumer behavior.
common_mistakes.correct: The data is used to analyze consumer behavior.
common_mistakes.explanation: be used to do 表示“被用来做某事”；be used to doing 表示“习惯于做某事”。这里表示用途，应使用不定式。

pte_usage.description: 不定式在 PTE Academic 中出现频率很高，尤其在 Summarize Written Text, Write Essay, Re-tell Lecture, Summarize Spoken Text 和 Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks 中非常常见。考生需要准确识别动词搭配、目的表达、被动不定式和形式主语结构。在写作中，不定式能帮助考生构建更清晰的因果、目的和评价句；在口语中，它可以使表达更流畅、更符合学术语域。
sections: Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks

academic_patterns.pattern: It is essential to + base verb
It is necessary to + base verb
It is difficult to + base verb
There is a need to + base verb
There is an opportunity to + base verb
The purpose of this study is to + base verb
academic_patterns.translation: 本研究的目的是做某事

academic_patterns.pattern: The policy aims to + base verb
This approach enables someone to + base verb
academic_patterns.translation: 这种方法使某人能够做某事

academic_patterns.pattern: Efforts should be made to + base verb
More resources need to be + past participle
academic_patterns.translation: 需要将更多资源用于或分配到某事

academic_patterns.pattern: The issue is likely to + base verb
academic_patterns.translation: 该问题很可能会做某事或产生某种结果

academic_patterns.pattern: The evidence appears to have + past participle
academic_patterns.translation: 证据似乎已经表明或产生了某种结果

ai_tips: 判断 to 后面是否接动词原形时，先确认 to 是不定式标志还是介词。want to do 中的 to 是不定式标志；look forward to doing 中的 to 是介词。
在 PTE 写作中，可以用“It is + adjective + to do”快速构建学术评价句，例如 It is crucial to reduce educational inequality.
遇到情态动词 can, should, must, may, might, could 后，不要加 to，直接使用动词原形。
如果句子强调目的，优先考虑使用 to do 或 in order to do，但不要过度重复 in order to，以免表达显得机械。
写学术句时，动词 enable, allow, require, encourage 后常接“object + to do”，适合描述政策、技术或教育措施的作用。

practice_questions.question: Choose the correct form: The university plans ___ more online courses next year. A. offer B. to offer C. offering
practice_questions.answer: B. to offer。plan 后通常接不定式，表示计划做某事。正确句子是：The university plans to offer more online courses next year.

practice_questions.question: Correct the sentence: Students should to review their notes regularly.
practice_questions.answer: Students should review their notes regularly. should 是情态动词，后面接 bare infinitive，不加 to。

practice_questions.question: Translate into English: 保护个人隐私是必要的。
practice_questions.answer: It is necessary to protect personal privacy.

practice_questions.question: Choose the correct form: The new system enables users ___ data more efficiently. A. analyze B. to analyze C. analyzing
practice_questions.answer: B. to analyze。enable + object + to do 表示“使某人能够做某事”。

practice_questions.question: Correct the sentence: The policy is designed to reducing waste.
practice_questions.answer: The policy is designed to reduce waste. be designed to do 表示“旨在做某事”，to 后接动词原形。

practice_questions.question: Choose the best academic sentence: A. There is a need improve public health services. B. There is a need to improve public health services. C. There is a need improving public health services.
practice_questions.answer: B. There is a need to improve public health services. a need 后常接不定式作后置定语。

practice_questions.question: Rewrite using passive infinitive: The government needs to allocate more funding to rural hospitals.
practice_questions.answer: More funding needs to be allocated to rural hospitals. 被动不定式形式为 to be + past participle。

practice_questions.question: Identify the infinitive phrase: It is difficult to measure the long-term effects of social media.
practice_questions.answer: to measure the long-term effects of social media 是不定式短语，在句中作真正主语；it 是形式主语。
